Our Story

About MAPA Business
& Financial Services LLC

A company founded with a clear purpose: to support the Latino community in New Jersey with reliable, accessible guidance — in their own language.

Our Story

MAPA Business & Financial Services LLC was born from Marilyn Paladinez's direct experience with the migrant community in Newark, New Jersey. Seeing the difficulties Latino families faced in accessing financial, notarial, and document preparation services in Spanish, Marilyn created a company that provides close, professional guidance.

Since its founding, MAPA has served families, entrepreneurs, and small businesses who needed help with their paperwork in a language they understand, from someone who understands their reality.

Today, MAPA Business is a trusted resource in Newark and surrounding New Jersey areas, with a presence in 13 cities and a wide range of specialized services for the Latino community.

Our Mission

Our mission is to guide Latino migrants, families, and entrepreneurs through the processes and services they need to establish themselves securely in the United States — always in Spanish and with respect for their journey and dreams.

Our Values

🤝
Trust

We work with honesty and transparency, explaining every step of the process.

🌎
Community

We understand the migrant experience because we are part of that story.

📋
Responsibility

We don't promise what we can't deliver. We guide with real, verifiable information.

💬
Spanish-Language Service

Spanish is our primary language. No one should feel lost because of a language barrier.

Founded and led by Marilyn Paladinez

Marilyn Paladinez is the founder of MAPA Business & Financial Services LLC. With over 10 years of field experience in the state of New Jersey, Marilyn has helped hundreds of families settle, protect their assets, and build solid credit histories.

Her approach is 100% strategic and educational, translating complex legal and institutional procedures into step-by-step plans in your own language.

Credentials and Certifications

📜 Certified New Jersey Notary Public (Active Commission) Authorized to notarize signatures, contracts, wills, powers of attorney, and affidavits statewide.
🔢 IRS Certified Acceptance Agent (CAA) Authorized to verify passports and identification documents in person for ITIN processing (Form W-7), keeping your original documents safe in your possession.
📋 Document Preparation Specialist Experienced in completing government tax forms (personal and business taxes), insurance applications, and employment authorization forms (I-765).

Frequently asked questions about MAPA Business

What is MAPA Business & Financial Services LLC?
A company founded by Marilyn Paladinez in Newark, New Jersey, that provides Spanish-language guidance to Latino migrant families, entrepreneurs, and small businesses in notarial, financial, and document preparation services.
Where is MAPA Business located?
We are at 20 Bloomfield Pl, Newark, NJ 07104. We also serve clients remotely throughout New Jersey.
Is MAPA Business a law firm?
No. MAPA Business & Financial Services LLC is not a law firm. Marilyn Paladinez is a certified Notary Public in New Jersey and provides guidance and document preparation. We do not offer legal representation or legal advice.
What are your business hours?
We are open Monday through Friday from 9am to 6pm, and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm. You can also reach us via WhatsApp at (862) 622-8339.
